summary: Strict review against .gitcode/code-style.md, .gitcode/review-memory.md, ARCHIVE-SPEC, the Track 2 Class A instructions and the common merge-error checklist found no P0/P1/P2/P3 issue. The official SourceForge URL and SHA-256 were verified; the single portability patch applies in the Conan source step; dependencies are published; only archives/p/pd-plugin is changed; no binary, source archive, generated cache or hidden runtime file is included. The HarmonyOS PC aarch64 conan create and the CI-equivalent build_and_test.sh pipeline both passed. The substantive runtime test executed 20 checks against the packaged external and a real LADSPA plugin, and the CI destructive negative test confirmed the test fails without the package artifact.
